title: The art of prompt engineering: making the most of AI at work

7ff5109f6bff.text: 📣 Note: This article is the introduction to a series I really want to share with you on a topic that's especially close to my heart: our relationship with AI in 2025

be894a5932b6.text: In 2025, AI is part of our everyday working lives, like a virtual colleague right there beside us. (Generative) AI tools now create text, images and sounds... with disconcerting ease. It's handy and powerful, but it makes us wonder: how do we stay in charge of our own work?

13989c46b780.text: I often see colleagues who lean on AI so much that they forget their own talents. It's a bit like letting a GPS guide you without ever learning to read a map - you lose something important along the way.

8d5c6f44a785.text: The good news? There's a solution: learning how to "talk" to AI. That's what we call

cd5f79cf6ed8.text: Imagine you're conducting an orchestra - AI is your ensemble of musicians, and you're the conductor setting the tempo. Even Sam Altman, the big boss of OpenAI, says so: knowing how to talk to AI is kind of the new foreign language to master!

f455e2dfeccd.text: #1 So what exactly is prompt engineering?

190bbe84e6f2.text: 💡 Imagine you're learning a new language, but this time with a very smart assistant.

8c0d206915ae.text: Prompt engineering is simply this: knowing how to communicate clearly with AI to get exactly what you need. It's like explaining something to a friend who really wants to help you!

ca1e1fc94b7d.text: is just the way you talk to it - a request or a question. The clearer and more precise you are in how you express yourself, the better the results.

c32bf615b594.text: #2 The basics you need to know

dc8e0ba701ed.text: I'm going to share the fundamentals with you - no need to drown in technical details to get started.

cd45f10a05a0.text: #3 AI: your copilot, not your replacement

28a573e8d88f.text: Think of AI as a super assistant that boosts your productivity. It's not taking your place, it's helping you shine!

7605d7bb1edb.text: #4 How do you get the most out of it?

9a50c6624c71.text: : Spot the tasks that bore you or take up too much of your time. That's where AI can lend you a hand, like with repetitive reports or simple presentations.

640ee064da34.text: : The better you know your field, the easier it'll be to communicate with AI. It's like learning to talk with a new colleague - it takes a bit of practice!

cbb8b7148c1c.text: : Trust, but verify! AI can get things wrong, so use your common sense and don't hesitate to ask questions if something seems off.

c34942e5e602.text: : It's like a dance - you need to find the right rhythm between what you do and what AI can do for you. The goal isn't to hand everything over to it, but to work in harmony.

04e77b0093e7.text: : Train yourself, swap notes with your colleagues, stay curious. That's how you stay one step ahead!

83c233cf2b6f.text: See AI as your personal assistant
: It's there for the repetitive tasks, while you focus on what really matters.

bd80927053a4.text: : Always double-check what AI suggests, just as you would with a new colleague.

9ee34761a2dc.text: : AI advises, but you're the one who decides!
